audience: shippers and logistics teams that book LTL, parcel and truckload freight in Freightview

useCases.title: Rate an LTL or parcel shipment
useCases.text: Create an LTL or parcel shipment draft to get rates. Nothing is booked. Read the quotes of the shipment with their quote ids and expiry times.

useCases.title: Book a quoted shipment after approval
useCases.text: After the user approves a quote and its price, book the LTL or parcel shipment with that quote. The booking commits the account to the carrier and its charge.

useCases.title: Track shipments and read their events
useCases.text: Search the shipments of the account with filters. Open one shipment, or read its tracking events for one item or for all items.

useCases.title: Review the carriers and locations on the account
useCases.text: List the carriers added to the account and its saved locations. Read the services of one carrier by its SCAC code.

useCases.title: Award a truckload shipment after approval
useCases.text: Create a truckload shipment draft with its stops and equipment. After the user approves a quote, award the shipment to the carrier of that quote.

useCases.title: Cancel a shipment after approval
useCases.text: Cancel an LTL, parcel or truckload shipment after the user approves the cancellation.
